mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 25bps does not correlate with accommodative policy.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each in a month signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with robust demand.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods with increasing GDPC1, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
